ideas.pitch: An interactive WebAR and mobile-based application that overlays 3D human anatomical models onto real-world surfaces for medical students to practice surgical pathways.
ideas.problem_statement: Transform education, healthcare, and industry using immersive technologies to solve real-world problems and enhance training.
ideas.title: AnatomyAR: Immersive Surgical Training
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting high-stakes domains like healthcare with clean AR overlays satisfies the judges' emphasis on real-world impact and technical implementation.

ideas.pitch: A WebXR virtual reality experience that reconstructs destroyed historical monuments from archival photographs, letting users walk through lost heritage sites.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore the potential of immersive technologies to transform tourism, entertainment, and education.
ideas.title: HeritageVR: Rebuilding Lost History
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an emotional and visually striking VR demo that is easy for judges to test quickly via browser-based WebXR.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and MediaPipe-powered XR application that guides patients through physical therapy movements with real-time skeletal feedback.
ideas.problem_statement: Demonstrate how AR/VR/XR can solve problems, enhance experiences, and create meaningful real-world impact in healthcare.
ideas.title: PoseFit XR: Interactive Physical Therapy Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard computer vision engineering with practical healthcare utility, matching winning patterns from motion capture and fitness hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An immersive AR mobile game that turns local urban environments into interactive water conservation puzzles based on real city watershed data.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore the potential of immersive technologies to transform education and industry while solving environmental problems.
ideas.title: EcoQuest AR: Water Conservation Exploration
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages gamification for social good, drawing inspiration from award-winning educational games that teach resource conservation.

ideas.pitch: A VR training simulation that drops industrial workers into hazardous factory scenarios to test and train safety protocols in a risk-free virtual space.
ideas.problem_statement: Transform industry and enterprise environments through immersive technologies to improve workplace safety.
ideas.title: IndusVR: Safe Industrial Hazard Simulation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies VR directly to enterprise use cases, which judges favor for clear commercial scalability and immediate real-world value.
